# ByaHero (Android)

The native Android shell for ByaHero, the smart commute predictor for the
Digos City mini bus system.

**This cross-platform app was generated by [Briefcase](https://briefcase.beeware.org/) - part of
[The BeeWare Project](https://beeware.org/). If you want to see more tools like Briefcase, please
consider [becoming a financial member of BeeWare](https://beeware.org/membership).**

## What it does

Plan a trip on the Kapatagan to Digos route: pick a route, origin,
destination, time of day and crowd level, and get back a travel time estimate
plus a leave-now-or-wait recommendation.

The app is a thin client over the same Flask API the web app uses, so both
always show the same predictions.

## Pointing it at the server

The app needs the address of a running ByaHero server. Set it with the
`BYAHERO_API` environment variable:

```bash
export BYAHERO_API=http://192.168.1.20:3000
```

- **Android emulator:** the host machine is `10.0.2.2`, which is the default.
- **Physical device:** use the computer's LAN IP, and make sure the phone and
  the computer are on the same network.
- **Device on the same Wi-Fi:** also confirm the server is bound to
  `0.0.0.0`, not just `127.0.0.1`.

Start the server for local network access with:

```bash
flask --app app run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
```

## Building

```bash
cd Byahero
briefcase create android
briefcase build android
briefcase run android
```

Requires the Android SDK, a JDK, and the Android NDK.
